stem:
Ishaan runs 150 m in 30 s. Rekha runs 100 m in 10 s.

Who is faster?

options.text: Ishaan, because he covers more distance.
Ishaan, because 5 m/s is greater than 10 m/s.
They cannot be compared, because the times differ.

teacher.key_rationale: Speed is distance per unit time, so Rekha at 10 m/s is faster than Ishaan at 5 m/s. Comparing distance alone, reversing which speed is larger, or refusing any comparison when times differ are wrong.
